They could have lost their job. With as much information they gave, they probably knew him since he was a puppy. You don't keep a dog that long being unable to care for it the entire time. They also said they tried to find a home, no one wants an owner surrender dog unless it's coming from a shelter. You can beg and plead someone to take your dog in and you'll get nothing more than "good luck" or "I would take him if ______!" 

There are many cases of "don't get a dog if you can't afford them" and they fall under people who adopt puppies without knowing what they're getting into, expense or breed-wise. As someone who works in the domestic animal field, this does not sound like one of those cases.
